description: Source file implementing the FrameRate plugin for managing display frame rate settings, including event handling, RPC methods, and internal state management.

classes.name: FrameRate
classes.description: Main plugin class managing frame rate settings, event handling, and RPC methods.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin and IARM communication.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources and deinitializes the plugin.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns plugin information.

methods.name: setCollectionFrequencyWrapper
methods.description: RPC wrapper to set frame rate collection frequency.

methods.name: startFpsCollectionWrapper
methods.description: RPC wrapper to start FPS collection.

methods.name: stopFpsCollectionWrapper
methods.description: RPC wrapper to stop FPS collection.

methods.name: updateFpsWrapper
methods.description: RPC wrapper to update FPS value.

methods.name: setFrmMode
methods.description: Sets the frame mode via RPC.

methods.name: getFrmMode
methods.description: Gets the current frame mode via RPC.

methods.name: setDisplayFrameRate
methods.description: Sets the display frame rate via RPC.

methods.name: getDisplayFrameRate
methods.description: Gets the current display frame rate via RPC.

methods.name: getCollectionFrequency
methods.description: Returns the current FPS collection interval in milliseconds.

methods.name: setCollectionFrequency
methods.description: Sets the FPS collection interval in milliseconds.

methods.name: startFpsCollection
methods.description: Starts FPS collection process.

methods.name: stopFpsCollection
methods.description: Stops FPS collection process and reports stats.

methods.name: updateFps
methods.description: Updates internal FPS statistics with a new value.

methods.name: fpsCollectionUpdate
methods.description: Sends FPS stats notification.

methods.name: onReportFpsTimer
methods.description: Timer callback to report FPS stats periodically.

methods.name: FrameRatePreChange
methods.description: Handles pre-change display frame rate event.

methods.name: frameRatePreChange
methods.description: Notifies about display frame rate pre-change.

methods.name: FrameRatePostChange
methods.description: Handles post-change display frame rate event.

methods.name: frameRatePostChange
methods.description: Notifies about display frame rate post-change.
